summary: Since Ansible 2.10, related modules should be developed in a collection; the section gives tips for companies and users building modules for products.
questions: Should I put a set of related modules in a collection?

answer_card.title: Develop related modules in a collection
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. Starting with **Ansible 2.10**, related modules should be developed in a collection. See the developing collections guide for format details.
